title: NL Scholarship (formerly known as Holland Scholarship)
official_source: Nuffic (Netherlands Organisation for Internationalisation in Education)
program_type: Government-funded partial scholarship (Ministry of Education plus Dutch universities)
description: The NL Scholarship, renamed from the Holland Scholarship, is financed by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science together with participating Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences. It awards EUR 5,000 to non-EEA students starting a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at a participating institution, paid during the first year of study, and the official page states it is not a full-tuition scholarship. title: Amsterdam Merit Scholarship (AMS)
program_type: University merit scholarship, awarded per faculty or Graduate School
duration: 1 year for a one-year master's; 2 years for a two-year master's provided at least 40 ECTS are passed in the first year
description: The Amsterdam Merit Scholarship (AMS) is a University of Amsterdam award for outstanding students from outside the EU/EEA who apply for a degree programme at the university. Applications are handled by the Admissions Offices of the Graduate Schools, and deadlines, eligibility requirements and selection criteria differ per faculty. The award is a grant and not a tuition waiver: the Faculty of Science states the recipient must still pay the full tuition fee and that the grant is paid in monthly instalments. title: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarship
program_type: University excellence scholarship financed by the Justus & Louise van Effen Fund
description: The Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships are financed by the legacy of Justus and Louise van Effen and administered by TU Delft together with Delft University Fund, with a minimum of 16 awards each year, two per faculty. Awarded students receive full tuition fees per year for a two-year regular TU Delft master's programme, based on the statutory or institutional rate for their nationality, plus a contribution towards living expenses. title: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) — Holland Scholarship & Talent Programmes
program_type: Government and university co-funded first-year scholarship for non-EEA master's students
duration: 1 year (award paid in the first year of study)
description: The Holland Scholarship, also called the NL Scholarship, is a Dutch government-funded award co-funded by participating universities and administered at school level at Erasmus University Rotterdam. EUR's institute pages document a EUR 5,000 award granted to one student per school on the basis of academic excellence, while the university's central pages list wider funding for incoming students and point applicants to Study in NL. It is a flat contribution towards study costs rather than full funding.

title: Leiden University Excellence Scholarship (LExS)
program_type: University excellence scholarship for incoming non-EEA/non-EFTA master's students
duration: The LExS is awarded for the duration of the study programme.
description: The Leiden University Excellence Scholarship is a study scholarship for excellent students joining a full-time Leiden University master's programme starting in September, with the exception of the non-advanced LLM and MSc programmes of Leiden Law School. Applicants must normally hold a non-EEA/non-EFTA passport and not be eligible for Dutch student finance. title: NL Scholarship (University of Groningen)
program_type: Government and university co-funded one-time grant for incoming non-EEA master's students
description: The University of Groningen's NL Scholarship is a one-time grant for international students from outside the EEA who wish to pursue a master's degree in the Netherlands, co-funded by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the university. It amounts to EUR 5,000, is awarded for one academic year only and can be received only once in a lifetime, and it is intended to help cover living expenses during the first year of study rather than to cover the full cost of studying. title: Utrecht University Excellence Scholarships
program_type: University talent scholarship (discontinued for new awards)
description: The Utrecht Excellence Scholarship was Utrecht University's scholarship for talented students in bachelor's and master's programmes. Following significant budget cuts the university states that the UES will no longer be offered for programmes starting in the 2026-2027 academic year and that no new applications will be accepted from the upcoming admissions cycle. Students already holding a UES continue to receive it as agreed, so the scheme is live for current award holders only.
